source: NOAA CoastWatch blended sea-surface geostrophic currents from satellite altimetry (0.25°, multi-mission: Sentinel-3A/B, CryoSat-2, Jason-2/3, SARAL) + NOAA NCEI blended sea-surface wind stress (0.25°, monthly, Version 2.0) + NOAA OISST v2.1 daily sea-surface temperature (0.25°, AVHRR-only, final)
attribution: Ocean surface currents: NOAA CoastWatch blended sea-surface geostrophic currents from satellite altimetry (0.25°, multi-mission: Sentinel-3A/B, CryoSat-2, Jason-2/3, SARAL). NOAA NCEI blended sea-surface wind stress (0.25°, monthly, Version 2.0). NOAA OISST v2.1 daily sea-surface temperature (0.25°, AVHRR-only, final). All U.S. Government works in the public domain; data courtesy of NOAA, altimetric products generated using AVISO+. Paths traced through the measured mean velocity field; names and seed points are editorial.
method: mean of 28 fields spread evenly across 2017-03-31…2026-06-23 on the source's native 0.25° grid, plus the Ekman surface current from 24 blended wind-stress fields (Ralph & Niiler 1999, B = 0.065 s^-1/2, 55° cum sole, tapered inside 2.5° of the equator); named paths integrated (RK2, 25 km steps, loop- and closure-detecting) from a published seed on each current's core; warm/cold MEASURED as the mean SST anomaly along each path against the zonal mean at the same latitude (NOAA OISST v2.1, 8 fields)
